component.name: ATK Control
component.summary: Configure ATK and VXE gaming mice

description.p: ATK Control is a native Qt 6 application for configuring ATK, VXE and Compx gaming mice on Linux. It talks to the mouse directly over raw HID.

ul.li: Battery percentage, charging state and voltage
DPI stages, active stage and per-stage colors
Polling rate, lift-off distance, debounce and sleep
Button remapping, lighting and on-board profiles
Protocol v1 and v2 support with read-back verification
